verdict.rationale: Metorial's entire value proposition is exposing connected apps as MCP tools that AI agents/clients (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) can operate via natural language, and portals let end users plug into that flow with a standard MCP URL. However, this is agent-mediated operation of *connected integrations*, not natural-language control of Metorial's own admin/config surfaces (dashboard, deployments, RBAC), which are managed via UI/SDK/API rather than NL commands. Missing for 10: evidence of natural-language commands controlling Metorial's own platform configuration/administration, and independent confirmation that NL-driven agent sessions work end-to-end in practice.
